title: Minimum Cost Homecoming of a Robot in a Grid
goal: Return a robot home with minimum entered-row and entered-column cost.
strategy: Any route must cross every intervening row and column. With nonnegative entry costs, a monotone route pays each required crossing once and avoids unnecessary detours.
